messages:
Maya: Final RN ready — can we lock pins and queue the deploybot job for the canary tomorrow morning?

Oliver: I can take canary ops. What exact start + window?

Maya: Plan: 09:00 PT start, 30m canary, then progressive if green. Internal note should go live at canary start (09:00).

Jeff: I will queue the job. Please paste the exact artifacts to pin.

Oliver: Pin list for production:
```
api-server: v3.12.1
inference-runtime: v4.0.0-rc2
model-store: ml-2026-03-19
```
Also please block auto-upgrades during the window.

Sara: Added RN paragraph + short internal blurb in doc. Draft internal copy:
"Heads up: rolling runtime perf + tracing updates. Expected ~5% median latency improvement. Canary 09:00 PT (30m). If errors spike >2x file in #support-ops with trace id."

Maya: Nice. Jeff — can deploybot post at start to #eng-releases with RN + runbook links and tag @oncall?

Jeff: Yep. Deploybot will post "Canary started — RN <link> — runbook <link>" and ping @oncall. Queueing now but won't trigger until Oliver flips the green in the UI.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy (ID:5443321000) for 2026-03-22 09:00 PT — canary 30m. Pins: inference-runtime=v4.0.0-rc2. Notifications: #eng-releases, @oncall. To cancel: /deploy cancel 5443321000

Oliver: Rollback criteria agreed:
- Errors >= 2x baseline for 5m
- p95 latency +200ms sustained for 10m
If met: immediate rollback to inference-runtime:v3.9.8 and notify exec-ops. Jeff will execute rollback commands and attach playbook.

Jeff: Adding watchlist to deploybot: healthcheck-failure, token-throttle, kv-cache-miss-rate. Auto-hold on triggers. I'll also pin a short rollback snippet to the RN doc.

Maya: Who will do quick checks at T+6 and T+18?

Oliver: I'll take T+6 verification (quick smoke: errors, p95, traces).

Jeff: I'll do T+18 and then call go/no-go for the progressive rollout.

Sara: Added metrics dashboards and alert thresholds to RN doc. Also added a one-liner about pinning: "We've pinned inference-runtime for the change window to keep behavior stable."

Jeff: Deploy job queued but waiting for Oliver to flip green. Attach rollback playbook and pinned comment in RN.

deploy-bot: To update time: /deploy update 5443321000 --time "2026-03-22T09:00:00-07:00" --canary 30m

Maya: I'll send the internal announce at 08:55 PT so it's visible before canary.

Oliver: Quick checklist done: RBAC verified, dashboards linked, alerts set. :thumbsup:

Sara: Final internal announcement copy (short):
"Heads up: We'll roll runtime performance and telemetry improvements tomorrow at 09:00 PT. Canary 30m. Minor, UX-neutral disruptions possible; ops updates in #eng-releases. For support, post in #support-ops with trace id."

Jeff: All set. I'll trigger only after Oliver flips green in the deploy UI.

Maya: Thanks team — standing by for the pre-announce and canary checks. :tada:
